title: Make CSV rerun mode choices explicit
summary: Expose CSV rerun Stage, Original, and Return mode controls in the Launch tab while keeping executable starts constrained to the existing copy / keep / park safety policy.
reason: The CSV rerun tab showed only readonly defaults, leaving operators without mode visibility or preflight evidence for blocked source-mutating choices.
behavior_before: CSV rerun displayed readonly Stage, Original, and Return fields set to copy, keep, and park, and request collection always sent those literals without surfacing blocked policy alternatives.
behavior_after: CSV rerun displays selectable Stage, Original, and Return intent fields, includes selected modes in preflight and live-start confirmation, and backend policy/preflight messages explicitly block move, delete, and replace_original before process launch.
tests_added: Updated tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_web_static_launch.py static assertions for CSV rerun mode controls and preflight warnings.
manual_validation: PASS: Select-String verification found the new CSV rerun select IDs, request collection fields, and mode warning text.
PASS: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.refresh_summaries --paths <CSV rerun touched paths>
BLOCKED: broader process/static unittest import is blocked by unrelated src/mediapipeline/core/processes/lifecycle.py syntax error in start_audit signature.
BLOCKED: broad targeted unittest bundle also reports unrelated audit-source effect and audit launch failures from in-flight audit source work.
rollback_plan: Restore the Launch CSV rerun Stage/Original/Return controls to readonly copy/keep/park display, revert request collection to literal safe defaults, and revert the CSV rerun policy/preflight/inventory wording updates.
notes: This change makes mode intent configurable in the WebView but intentionally does not enable source-mutating or in-place CSV rerun execution. Enabling move, delete, or replace_original remains a separate high-risk media-policy change requiring boundary review and real-media validation. The worktree contains unrelated dirty changes, including path picker, audit source, library summary, and generated inventory updates; this packet only claims the CSV rerun mode-control work.
